source_name: SDAT Real Property Data Search
verification_note: Exact URL appeared in WebSearch results for the SDAT bulk-data query.
terms_notes: Per-parcel lookup UI; no documented API. Also the entry point to the 'View GroundRent Registration' link per parcel.
difficulty_reason: Per-parcel manual lookup; use the Socrata bulk dataset instead for volume.
notes: Maryland assesses at 100% of market value on a TRIENNIAL cycle (one-third of the state reassessed each year; increases phased in over 3 years, decreases applied immediately). Statewide system since the 1979 reform — 'last reassessment year' varies by assessment group (each property is on a 3-year group cycle), not by county. Statewide covers all six metro counties.

source_name: SDAT Ground Rent Registry (Maryland ground-lease oddity)

terms_notes: Registration mandatory for residential ground leases since 2007 reform; unregistered ground rents are not legally collectible.

source_name: MDLandRec.net (Maryland State Archives / Judiciary land records)
verification_note: Service confirmed by multiple search snippets (MSA guide PDF msa.maryland.gov/msa/refserv/pdf/md-landrecords.pdf and county circuit-court pages describe 'MdLandRec.net'), but the bare URL itself never appeared as a literal result link — recorded from the service's well-attested name.
update_frequency: continuous (as recorded at each circuit court)
terms_notes: Free one-time account registration (email; password issued ~1 hour on business days). No bulk index download; per-document image retrieval. Covers every Maryland county's circuit-court land records — deeds, mortgages, liens, releases, plats.
difficulty_reason: Free but registration-gated, image-based, no bulk index; searching is by grantor/grantee/liber-folio.
notes: This is the recorder source for ALL jurisdictions in this metro (MD records deeds at county circuit courts). State transfer tax: 0.5% of consideration statewide, on top of county transfer + recordation taxes (see per-county entries).

source_name: Maryland Judiciary Case Search
verification_note: Exact URL in search results; FAQ at courts.state.md.us/casesearch2/faq also confirmed.
terms_notes: CAPTCHA added March 2022 explicitly to prevent automated scraping; terms prohibit interfering with Judiciary systems (criminal/civil penalties cited). Governed by Maryland Rules on Access to Court Records. Treat as MANUAL-ONLY; do not scrape. (Historical scraper CaseHarvester on GitHub predates the CAPTCHA.)
difficulty_reason: CAPTCHA wall + anti-automation terms; per-case manual lookup only.
notes: Covers circuit-court mortgage foreclosure dockets (MD foreclosures are trustee sales docketed in circuit court, e.g. Baltimore City = 8th Judicial Circuit) AND District Court landlord-tenant cases statewide. Key eviction-data caveat: 'failure to pay rent' cases that end without a judgment of possession are SHIELDED within 60 days of closure, so FTPR history visible online is systematically incomplete.
